Core (rates/equity/commodity) transaction + clearing volume durability and rate-per-contract through the post-2025-volatility normalization, versus documented competitive erosion at the edges (FMX in SOFR/Treasury, perpetual-futures venues in commodities/equities, Cboe zero-DTE) — the moat is capital efficiency (~$95B/day margin savings) and single-pool margin offsets; the swing is whether that holds core share while the stacked new bets (24/7 crypto, single-stock futures, event contracts, Treasury clearing) convert to material revenue.
